candidates: Remove all `console.log`, `console.warn`, and other debug console statements from committed code (including parser validators, renderers, and diagram utilities). Use the project's structured logger (`log.debug`, `log.error`, etc.) for any logging that should persist into production.

In documentation examples and Cypress integration tests, configure diagrams using YAML frontmatter (`---
config:
  ...
---`) instead of the legacy `%%{init: ...}%%` directive syntax. The project has standardized on frontmatter for all diagram configuration; the old init-directive form must not appear in new or updated examples.

New files added to `demos/` must match the HTML boilerplate conventions (DOCTYPE format, attribute quoting, meta tags, script structure) of existing demo files in that directory. When in doubt, copy the structure of a nearby demo file rather than starting from scratch.

Diagram DB modules must wrap all mutable state in `ImperativeState` (from `../../utils/imperativeState.js`) rather than using plain module-level variables. Prefer the new class-based DB architecture over the functional-export pattern when introducing a new diagram type.

Function parameters that receive a delimited string representing multiple values (e.g., comma-separated CSS styles) should be named in the plural (e.g., `styles` rather than `style`) to accurately signal that the value is a collection. Avoid the underscore prefix (`_name`) on parameters that are actually read inside the function body.

In Langium grammar files (`.langium`), if you intentionally omit the import of the project's shared common grammar (which other diagram grammars conventionally import), add an inline comment that explains the reason—e.g., that the common grammar introduces ambiguity or parser conflicts with this grammar's own token/rule definitions.

In diagram documentation's 'Related Diagrams' or 'See Also' sections, every currently-supported Mermaid diagram type that is mentioned must include a relative hyperlink to its documentation page (e.g., `[Pie Charts](./pie.md)`). Diagram types that are not yet released may be mentioned in plain text without a link.
